plans.summary: This 10-work plan focuses on improving a midfielder's passing range, box-to-box movement, ball retention, vision, and pressing skills, while also strengthening their ankle and improving agility.
plans.title: Midfielder Training Plan

drills.instructions: Roll the ball with your feet, focusing on keeping it close to your body.
drills.name: Ball Control Drills
tips: Keep your knees slightly bent and your weight evenly distributed on both feet.
Focus on using the inside of your foot to control the ball.

drills.instructions: Juggle the ball with your feet, focusing on keeping it in the air for as long as possible.
drills.name: Ball Juggling
tips: Keep your head up and your eyes on the ball at all times.
Use the laces of your shoes to control the ball.

drills.instructions: Pass the ball to your friend with different levels of force, focusing on accuracy and control.
drills.name: Passing Range
tips: Keep your ankle locked and your toes pointed down when striking the ball.
Focus on using the inside of your foot to pass the ball.

days.warmup: 10 minutes of ball control drills and juggling.

drills.instructions: Run back and forth between two points, focusing on maintaining a high tempo and covering a lot of ground.
drills.name: Box-to-Box Movement
tips: Keep your head up and your eyes scanning the field at all times.
Focus on using your quick changes of direction to beat your opponent.

drills.instructions: Pass the ball to your friend with different levels of difficulty, focusing on reading the game and making smart decisions.
drills.name: Vision and Passing
tips: Keep your eyes on the ball and your friend at all times.
Focus on using your vision to read the game and make smart passes.

drills.instructions: Press your friend and try to win the ball back, focusing on maintaining possession and creating scoring opportunities.
drills.name: Pressing and Ball Retention
tips: Keep your head up and your eyes on the ball at all times.
Focus on using your quick changes of direction to beat your opponent and win the ball back.

days.warmup: 10 minutes of ball control drills and juggling.

drills.instructions: Play out game situations with your friend, focusing on making smart decisions and creating scoring opportunities.
drills.name: Game Situation Drills
tips: Keep your eyes on the ball and your friend at all times.
Focus on using your vision to read the game and make smart decisions.

days.warmup: 10 minutes of ball control drills and juggling.

plans.notes: Remember to take regular breaks to avoid exacerbating your ankle injury.
nutrition_tips: Stay hydrated throughout the training session.
Eat a balanced meal 1-2 hours before training.
